headline: VMS TMT suspends Bavla operations after furnace breakdown
summary: VMS TMT Ltd reported a furnace breakdown at its Bavla facility on October 30, 2026. Operations are temporarily suspended with no injuries reported.

headline: EFC (I) Ltd Q2FY27 Results
summary: EFC (I) Ltd reported a qualified audit opinion on Q2FY27 results due to unbilled revenue and receivables. Consolidated PAT rose to ₹7,726 lakh.

headline: Stocks to Watch Today: VRL Logistics, KRBL, Petronet LNG in focus
summary: VRL Logistics rallies 7.3% on buyback and strong earnings, while KRBL jumps 5.2% on profit surge. ITC slips as margins contract despite revenue beat.

headline: Amalgamated Electricity passes preferential issue resolution
summary: Amalgamated Electricity Company Limited passed special resolutions for a preferential issue and object clause change via postal ballot. Promoters voted unanimously in favour.

headline: Grain ethanol producers seek FY27 price, allocation changes
summary: Grain ethanol producers have requested price revisions and allocation adjustments for FY27, citing supply disruption risks and challenges faced by maize-based distilleries.

headline: Escorts Kubota cuts FY27 tractor forecast to decline
summary: Escorts Kubota revises FY27 tractor industry outlook to a slight single-digit decline after 8% H1 growth, citing weak rainfall and flat exports.

headline: Magellanic Cloud UAV facility ready
summary: Magellanic Cloud Ltd confirms readiness of UAV facility premises under JV MCRAY XTEND INDIA. Facility supports end-to-end drone manufacturing and testing.

headline: IndiGo CEO calls for lower airport fees and taxes
summary: IndiGo CEO Willie Walsh has called for lower airport fees and taxes, citing rising ATF prices and business costs, while stating the airline is absorbing expenses to maintain financial stability.

headline: India 10-year bond yield eases to 7.2892%
summary: India's 10-year benchmark government bond yield fell to 7.2892% from the previous close of 7.3154%, indicating a decline in yields.

headline: Centre mandates airlines to disclose full ticket charges
summary: The Centre has issued new aircraft rules requiring airlines to share detailed ticket charges, including cancellation fees, with passengers at the time of booking.

headline: Restaurant inflation hits 9.36% in September
summary: Rising costs of milk, onions, sugar, and commercial LPG are pushing restaurants to raise menu prices, with restaurant inflation reaching 9.36% in September, squeezing profit margins.

headline: UPL Superform specialty chemicals eyes growth
summary: UPL's Superform specialty chemicals unit anticipates continued revenue and EBIT growth over the next two quarters, driven by volume gains, new product launches, and contract manufacturing.

headline: Asus targets 25% share of India's PC market
summary: Asus aims for a 25% overall PC market share in India, plans to raise its consumer PC share to 30%, and already holds a 31-33% share in the gaming PC segment.

headline: Viviana Power Tech Q2 EBITDA jumps 116% YoY
summary: Viviana Power Tech reported Q2 EBITDA of ₹177 million, up from ₹82 million YoY. Revenue surged to ₹1.17 billion, though margins contracted slightly to 15.1%.

headline: Cement firms raise prices amid higher input costs
summary: Cement companies have increased prices to offset rising input costs, with seasonal demand and government infrastructure spending expected to support sales volumes.

headline: Maruti Suzuki exports rise 30% amid West Asia crisis
summary: Maruti Suzuki posted a 30% rise in exports, with shipments in the first 10 months of CY26 already surpassing the full-year CY25 record, despite disruptions from the West Asia crisis.

headline: Reliance Industries block trade on NSE
summary: A block trade of approximately 6,56,688 shares of Reliance Industries was executed on the NSE at ₹1,293.30 per share, aggregating to ₹84.93 crore.

headline: Axis Bank shares flag large-trade signal on NSE
summary: A large-trade signal flagged approximately 2,22,890 Axis Bank shares changing hands on NSE at ₹1,213.10, with a combined value of ₹27.04 crore.

headline: Govt consults agri firms to ease sector regulations
summary: The government has initiated consultations with seed, fertilizer, and agricultural export companies to identify regulations that are hindering business operations in the agriculture sector.

headline: Govt reviews customs duty on 118 items for Budget 2027-28
summary: The government is evaluating basic customs duty concessions and exemptions for 118 items ahead of Budget 2027-28, covering power equipment, display components, textile machinery, battery scrap, solar cells, drugs, and optical fibre cables.
